These companies have switched their battery powered forklifts to clean hydrogen power

I am always a proponent towards more sustainable energy solutions but moving from battery to hydrogen really hasn't improved the cleanliness by much at all.

While it's true that if you're using an electric vehicle you are probably using coal power - the same could apply for the method of hydrogen extraction. Generally they use electrolysis to separate the hydrogen atoms from the oxygen atom in water. This isn't a magical process, it requires electricity, which will most likely be supplied by coal power of some sort.

They haven't reduced emissions in their warehouse either, if anything they've increased the humidity in their warehouses which would beg me to question the effects on the products in a more humid environment. AC could be used to reduce this humidity but that's more coal energy right there. Not to mention if there is a fire in your warehouse when you have 4 or 5 of these suckers lined up.
